description: This Java class LogWrapper wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with potential chaining to other LogNode instances, enabling flexible log processing.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's Log utility and supports chaining for log processing.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable; also passes the log to the next node if chain exists.
